fixer.title: settings: reuse the search index instead of rebuilding it on every search

introducer.title: Add TF-IDF as a backup option for settings search

cases.mechanism: Every debounced nonexact Settings search rebuilt the complete TF-IDF corpus synchronously on the renderer thread, despite cached documents and an unchanged settings model. With Q searches and T total setting text/terms, this repeated O(Q*T) corpus tokenization and term-frequency/occurrence-map allocation before calculating rankings.
cases.symptom: Repeated related-settings searches incurred renderer-thread blocking and allocation proportional to the entire settings corpus before final search results could be rendered. This consequence is statically established by the synchronous updateDocuments implementation and awaited editor call path; timings from PR metadata were not independently verified.
cases.fixedBehavior: Build and retain a single TF-IDF index on the first nonempty related-settings search for the current settings-model identity; reuse it for subsequent queries and replace it when the model changes. Corpus-wide tokenization and term-map allocation no longer repeat for warm searches.
cases.evidence: The deleted base line 518 called updateDocuments(this._documents) unconditionally inside getTfIdfItems for every nonempty TF-IDF search. settingsEditor2.ts triggerFilterPreferences awaits doRemoteSearch after local matching unless there is an exact match; doRemoteSearch -> searchWithProvider -> RemoteSearchProvider.searchModel -> TfIdfSearchProvider.searchModel -> getTfIdfItems. TfIdfCalculator.updateDocuments (tfIdf.ts:118-149) synchronously tokenizes every document chunk, builds per-document term-frequency maps, and updates corpus occurrence maps. The new line 507 builds the calculator only under the existing model-identity check, while the added calculateScores line reuses it. The added test explicitly expects two builds for three searches across two models. Blame of base line 518 attributes the unconditional build to the returned introducing commit.
